lines.en: label futabanew1:
I knock on Futaba’s door and wait for her to answer, knowing full well that she will because she is Futaba and I am the knight in shining armor that she dreams about each night.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等她来应门——我完全清楚她一定会来开，因为她是 Futaba，而我是她每晚都会梦见的那个白马王子。

lines.en: It’s not a role I ever imagined assuming, and I’m not about to start acting chivalrous now that I’ve come out and acknowledged it.
lines.zh: 这不是我设想过自己会扮演的角色，而且既然已经说破了、承认了，我也没打算从此开始装什么骑士风度。

lines.en: But it {i}is{/i} nice knowing that someone out there is willing to entrust their whole self to me.
lines.zh: 不过知道这世上有人愿意把自己整个托付给我，感觉倒{i}是{/i}不错。

lines.en: I say this despite having not yet taken any of the interesting parts of her into my arms.
lines.zh: 尽管我还没把她身上那些有趣的部分拥入怀中，我依然这么说。

lines.en: I say this despite not having anything to save her from.
lines.zh: 尽管根本没有什么需要我把她从中拯救出来的东西，我依然这么说。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 请进！

lines.en: scene black
I steel my nerves in preparation for a late night encounter with a damsel undistressed.
lines.zh: 我硬着头皮做好心理准备，迎接与一位并不身处危难中的少女的深夜相会。

lines.en: Her room smells of the same lavender perfume she so commonly wears.
lines.zh: 她的房间里还是那股她常喷的薰衣草香水味。

lines.en: And my mind sinks to the same depths it so commonly hides away in.
lines.zh: 而我的思绪，也沉进了它一贯藏身的那个深处。

lines.en: scene futabarevision1
: Hey...Sorry for looking like this again. I planned on spending the rest of the night writing, so I got changed as soon as I came home.
lines.zh: : 嘿……抱歉又让你看到我这副样子。我本来就打算把今晚剩下的时间拿来写作，所以一回家就换好衣服了。

lines.en: : I hope...that’s okay?
lines.zh: : 希望……你不介意？

lines.en: : It will never {i}not{/i} be okay. And I’m glad to see you’re still throwing yourself at this story.
lines.zh: : 永远都{i}不会{/i}介意。而且我很高兴看到你还在为这个故事全力以赴。

lines.en: scene futabarevision2
: I would have had a harder time {i}not{/i} throwing myself at it after all of the encouragement you gave me after reading the first part.
lines.zh: : 你在读完第一部分之后给了我那么多鼓励，我要是{i}不{/i}全力以赴反而更难。

lines.en: scene futabarevision3
: In fact, I’ve already made tons of changes! I even brought Pedro back to life!
lines.zh: : 事实上，我已经改了好多地方！我甚至让 Pedro 复活了！

lines.en: : Good. He never deserved death in the first place.
lines.zh: : 很好。他一开始就罪不至死。

lines.en: scene futabarevision4
: No...I actually felt really bad when I seriously started thinking about it. Which...I probably shouldn’t since he’s just a character I made up, but...
lines.zh: : 不……当我认真去想这件事的时候，其实真的很难过。虽然……我大概不该这样，毕竟他只是我编出来的一个角色，可是……

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard...{i}not{/i} getting attached to...people and creatures inside of your head, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 对活在你脑子里的人和生物……很难{i}不产生{/i}感情，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Well, I haven’t written anything in...longer than I can remember. But I get what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我已经……久到记不清有多久没写过东西了。但我明白你的意思。

lines.en: scene futabarevision2
: Pedro isn’t...the only character that’s changed either.
lines.zh: : Pedro 也不是……唯一一个被改动的角色。

lines.en: : Oh? Does my-
lines.zh: : 哦？那我的——

lines.en: : Or, uhh...sorry. {i}Does the male character{/i} have anything interesting about him yet? Or is he still the...blank slate he’s designed to be?
lines.zh: : 或者，呃……抱歉。那个{i}男性角色{/i}身上有什么有意思的地方了吗？还是说他仍然是……一开始设定的那种白纸？

lines.en: scene futabarevision5
: I don’t think he’s a blank slate at all. I actually...really like him for who he is in the beginning of the book. And he’ll develop even more as the story progresses.
lines.zh: : 我完全不觉得他是白纸。其实……我挺喜欢他在书最开始时的样子。而且随着故事推进，他还会成长更多。

lines.en: : All of the biggest changes...actually involve the heroine of the story.
lines.zh: : 最大的改动……其实都在故事的女主角身上。

lines.en: : Oh?
Well, that’s unexpected. I was pretty sure that Futaba’s Mary Sue esque protagonist was just her version of a self-insert-
lines.zh: 嗯，这倒是出乎意料。我本来挺确定，Futaba 那个玛丽苏式的女主角就是她给自己安插的化身——

lines.en: A way to sneak into her story on a more personal level without naming the character “Futaba.”
lines.zh: 一种不把角色叫「Futaba」，却能在更私人的层面上溜进自己故事里的方法。

lines.en: But apparently, she wasn’t good enough to make the final cut.
lines.zh: 但看来，她不够好，没能留到最后。

lines.en: Take that as you will.
lines.zh: 怎么理解随你。

lines.en: : Why did you change her, exactly? The story seemed...completely built around her.
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么改她？这故事看起来……完全是围着她搭起来的。

lines.en: scene futabarevision6
: And it still is.
lines.zh: : 现在依然是。

lines.en: : But...I read the story again right after you left the library...and something about her just didn’t sit right with me.
lines.zh: : 但是……你离开图书馆之后我又把故事读了一遍……她身上有什么地方让我觉得不对劲。

lines.en: : Do you know what that {i}something{/i} was?
lines.zh: : 你知道是{i}什么{/i}地方吗？

lines.en: : Flaws.
lines.zh: : 缺点。

lines.en: : All of the best protagonists are flawed. They all have problems...traumas...things that make them feel more human.
lines.zh: : 所有最出色的主角都是有缺点的。他们都有烦恼……创伤……那些让他们更像人的东西。

lines.en: : Well, the girl in your story was lonely, wasn’t she? I figured her reclusive nature was her biggest flaw.
lines.zh: : 你故事里的那个女孩很孤独啊，不是吗？我以为她那种离群索居的性格就是她最大的缺点。

lines.en: : I don’t...really think that being lonely is a flaw. That’s more of a...result. And the way I had it portrayed made her feel like a victim of sorts.
lines.zh: : 我……其实不觉得孤独是一种缺点。那更像是……一种结果。而我写出来那个样子，让她感觉像个受害者。

lines.en: : I never wanted that.
lines.zh: : 我从没想过要那样。

lines.en: : That’s why she didn’t sit right with me. It felt wrong to have her enjoying herself and living her best life without ever revealing her...true colors to anyone. Or any of the things that make her whole.
lines.zh: : 那就是她让我觉得不对劲的原因。让她过得开心、活出最好的样子，却从不向任何人展露自己的……真面目，也不展露那些让她完整的部分，这让我觉得不对。

lines.en: : You have...gotten significantly better at writing since the last time we spoke.
lines.zh: : 从我们上次聊过之后，你的写作……进步明显啊。

lines.en: scene futabarevision7
: D-Don’t just jump the gun and go saying things like that before even reading the changes, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 别……别还没看我改的地方就抢先说这种话，Sensei。

lines.en: : This is just my...experience as a reader coming into play. I still have a long way to go before I can create something I’m completely proud of.
lines.zh: : 这只是我……作为一个读者的经验起了作用。我离能创造出让自己完全自豪的东西，还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: : Until then, I just have to...keep trying things in different ways and hoping they come out a little more interesting...
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我只能……不断用不同的方式去尝试，希望结果能再有趣一点……

lines.en: scene futabarevision8
: After all, I...
lines.zh: : 毕竟，我……

lines.en: : I want the heroine to entertain you. And what’s the point in getting to know someone when all they are can be found on just one small sheet of paper?
lines.zh: : 我想让这个女主角能取悦你。再说，如果一个人的全部都能被写在一张小小的纸上，那认识这个人又有什么意义？

lines.en: scene futabarevision9
: A-A-And by “you” I meant the reader! Not {i}you!{/i}
lines.zh: : 而、而且我说的「你」是读者！不是{i}你{/i}！

lines.en: : I want...anyone who reads the story to be interested in the protagonist! Even if...you {i}are{/i} the only person I plan on showing this to!
lines.zh: : 我想……让任何读这个故事的人都会对主角感兴趣！就算……我打算给它看的{i}只有你{/i}一个人！

lines.en: : This is the same exact “mutated reflection” I was talking to you about.
lines.zh: : 这就是我跟你说过的那个「变异的倒影」。

lines.en: scene futabarevision10
: Huh? It is?
lines.zh: : 啊？是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s only natural for a writer to put a little bit of themself into the main character of a story they’re writing.
lines.zh: : 嗯。一个作家把自己身上一点点东西放进自己笔下的主角里，这是再自然不过的事。

lines.en: : You didn’t like how flawless the heroine of your story was because she didn’t remind you at all of how you see yourself, right?
lines.zh: : 你之所以不喜欢你故事里那个完美无缺的女主角，是因为她一点都不像你眼中的自己，对吧？

lines.en: scene futabarevision11
: Well, umm...I...I suppose that’s at least...somewhat true...
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃……我……我想至少……有几分是真的……

lines.en: : It’s...It’s not as if I was...modeling the main character after myself or anything. That would be...conceited...
lines.zh: : 我……我又不是……照着自己的样子去塑造主角的。那样太……自以为是了……

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : If it was, I don’t think you would have spent the whole day trying to make the character worse.
lines.zh: : 如果是的话，我想你也不会花一整天的时间把这个角色变糟糕了。

lines.en: scene futabarevision12
: Using the word “worse” is...a little hurtful. I think...a person’s flaws are one of the many things that can make that person beautiful.
lines.zh: : 用「变糟糕」这个词……有点伤人。我觉得……一个人的缺点，也是让这个人变得美丽的众多原因之一。

lines.en: : It’s only when there are...far too many of them that people become ugly...
lines.zh: : 只有当它们……多得过分的时候，人才会变丑……

lines.en: : And how many {i}flaws{/i} would you say that you have, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得自己有多少{i}缺点{/i}，Futaba？

lines.en: : Futaba-
lines.zh: : Futaba——

lines.en: : If I tried to write them all down, I’d run out of paper.
lines.zh: : 如果我要把它们全写下来，纸会不够用。

lines.en: scene futabarevision7
: But, umm...I know that’s not really something you want to hear about and...you’ve already given me {i}one{/i} assignment, so it’s not like I can just tack on another one.
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……我知道这种事你其实并不想听，而且……你已经给我布置过{i}一个{/i}任务了，我也不好再往上加一个。

lines.en: : Especially one as silly as that...I’m just...I’m just being a little dramatic. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 尤其是像那么蠢的一个……我只是……我只是有点小题大做。就这样。

lines.en: : All of this talk about flawed characters and...what heroines are supposed to be like has made me a little self conscious. It’ll pass in no time at all and...I’m sorry for talking so much about it.
lines.zh: : 聊了这么多关于有缺点的角色、还有女主角应该是什么样的话题，让我有点不自在了。它很快就会过去的……抱歉我说了这么多。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I don’t really think you were telling the truth anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我也不太觉得你说的是真心话。

lines.en: scene futabarevision10
: You...don’t?
lines.zh: : 你……不信？

lines.en: : Nope. Because if having too many flaws really made someone undesirable, you’d stop smiling every time you see me.
lines.zh: : 不信。因为如果缺点太多真的会让一个人变得不讨人喜欢，那你每次见到我就不会笑了。

lines.en: : Was that...a line from a book?
lines.zh: : 那……是从书里抄来的吗？

lines.en: : You think I could have just remembered a specific, relevant quote like that off the top of my head? Of course that wasn’t from a book.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我能随口就背出一句这么贴切的话？那当然不是从书里来的。

lines.en: : You should...put it in one. You’re so much better at this than I am.
lines.zh: : 你应该……把它写进书里。你在这方面比我强太多了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, I’ve probably had a lot more practice than you. I’m a teacher after all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧，我大概只是练得比你多。毕竟我是老师。

lines.en: Even if this isn’t something I would have chosen to do on my own.
lines.zh: 尽管这本来不是我自己会选的路。

lines.en: scene futabarevision4
: Umm...do you...maybe want to step outside for a little while?
lines.zh: : 呃……你要不要……出去待一会儿？

lines.en: : I think a...break might be nice. I’ve been kind of going nonstop since I got back and...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……休息一下可能挺好。我回来之后就一直没停过，而且……

lines.en: : I’d like to talk a little more...if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我还想再多聊一会儿……可以的话。

lines.en: : It’s fine. But I think you might want to get dressed first. I can’t imagine you’d be very happy with the whole world seeing you like that when you’re still embarrassed about {i}me{/i} seeing you in that condition.
lines.zh: : 可以。不过{i}我{/i}觉得你最好先换好衣服。你连被我看到这副样子都还会害羞，要是被全世界看到，我想你肯定不会开心。

lines.en: scene futabarevision13
: {size=-10}It’s only a problem because it {i}is{/i} you...{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}问题只在于那个人{i}是{/i}你……{/size}

lines.en: : Hm? What was that?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你说了什么？

lines.en: scene futabarevision7
: Oh! Umm...nothing!
lines.zh: : 啊！呃……没什么！

lines.en: : Just...please go wait in the hall for me.
lines.zh: : 只是……请你在走廊等我一下。

lines.en: : I’ll get changed and...be back in a moment.
lines.zh: : 我去换好衣服……马上就回来。

lines.en: scene black
I exit the room, but my mind stays put to watch one of my students undress.
lines.zh: 我走出房间，我的思绪却留在原地，看着我的一个学生脱下衣服。

lines.en: She’s thinking about me right now. She has to be.
lines.zh: 她现在正在想我。她一定在想。

lines.en: It only makes sense for her to be thinking about me when I’m right here and she is right there, hastily removing her pants so I’m not kept waiting long.
lines.zh: 我人就在这儿，而她就在那儿，急匆匆地脱着裤子，好让我不用等太久——她会想着我，那是再自然不过的事。

lines.en: I would help her if she’d only ask.
lines.zh: 只要她开口，我就会去帮她。

lines.en: Just like with writing, I would teach her all there is to know about love in its most bestial, physical form.
lines.zh: 就像写作一样，我会把爱最兽性、最肉体的一面，毫无保留地教给她。

lines.en: I think the same things about her that she thinks about me.
lines.zh: 我对她的那些想法，和她对我的想法是一样的。

lines.en: But I am different.
lines.zh: 但我和她不同。

lines.en: I would indulge in my desires.
lines.zh: 我会纵容自己的欲望。

lines.en: And she would rather bring form to her flaws than allow me to peel them back like underwear, stuck to the damp petals of a flower unplucked from its original garden.
lines.zh: 而她宁愿给自己的缺点一个形状，也不肯让我把它们像内裤那样剥下来——那条内裤，正黏在一朵还没被摘离原本花园的花的湿润花瓣上。

lines.en: Hurry up and finish before I return to the depths.
lines.zh: 趁我还没回到深处，快点弄完。

lines.en: scene futabarevision14
We eventually make our way outside and I am able to force away the urge to undress her on my own.
lines.zh: 我们最后还是走到了外面，而我也总算压下了亲自动手把她剥光的冲动。

lines.en: I don’t know where her mind ends up, but based on the nonexistent distance between her right arm and my left, I think I may have won the race toward the fleeting purity of this blossoming connection.
lines.zh: 我不知道她的心思飘到了哪里，但看她右臂和我左臂之间那段根本不存在的距离，我想在这场奔向这段正在绽放的关系、那稍纵即逝的纯真的赛跑里，我大概是赢了。

lines.en: The petals are mine to pluck as soon as the flower finishes blooming.
lines.zh: 等这朵花彻底绽放，那些花瓣就归我采摘了。

lines.en: Oh, if only spring would come tonight.
lines.zh: 啊，要是春天今夜就到就好了。

lines.en: : The...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : The character in my story isn’t...an {i}exact{/i} representation of me, you know...
lines.zh: : 我故事里的那个角色……并不是我的{i}精确{/i}写照，你知道的……

lines.en: : I still haven’t met the new version, so I’ll hold my comments until I do.
lines.zh: : 我还没见过新版，所以等见到了再下评论。

lines.en: : And I...
lines.zh: : 而我……

lines.en: : I want you to know that...I don’t think you’re as flawed as you suggested earlier.
lines.zh: : 我想让你知道……我觉得你并不像你刚才说的那么满身缺点。

lines.en: : I think you’re really amazing, Sensei. And...it probably sounds silly, but...I wouldn’t trade even moments like this one for anything.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你真的很了不起，Sensei。而且……听起来可能很傻，但是……就算是像现在这样的片刻，我也什么都不换。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah...
scene futabarevision15
: I guess I...just wanted you to know that before the night comes to an end...
lines.zh: : 我想我只是……想在今晚结束之前让你知道这件事……

lines.en: : Then I’ll say the same thing to you.
lines.zh: : 那我把同样的话送给你。

lines.en: : You’re not even half as flawed as you think you are.
lines.zh: : 你身上的缺点，连你自己以为的一半都不到。

lines.en: : Have you stopped to think that...maybe I just haven’t been revised yet?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过……也许我只是还没被修订过？

lines.en: : You haven’t seen the flaws because...they haven’t been added into my story yet.
lines.zh: : 你之所以看不到那些缺点，是因为……它们还没被写进我的故事里。

lines.en: : Who’s to say if you’ll still be saying things like that when they are?
lines.zh: : 等它们被写进去的时候，谁说得准你还会不会说这种话？

lines.en: : Hm.
scene futabarevision14
: Well, the same goes for me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那对我大概也一样。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping we don’t wind up hating each other once we learn a little more.
lines.zh: : 但愿等我们再多了解彼此一点之后，不会开始讨厌对方。

lines.en: : You’d...have to do something {i}really{/i} bad to get me to hate you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你得……做出{i}很{/i}过分的事，我才会讨厌你，Sensei……

lines.en: : I’m sure I will eventually.
lines.zh: : 我早晚会的。

lines.en: : So...until then...
lines.zh: : 那么……在那之前……

lines.en: : Is it okay for me to stay with you like this?
lines.zh: : 我可以像这样待在你身边吗？

lines.en: : Like what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 像什么样，具体说说？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it...
lines.zh: : 别在意了……

lines.en: : It would just make me sound dumb if I said it out loud.
lines.zh: : 说出来的话，只会显得我很傻。

lines.en: : Then write it down. You’re getting pretty good at that now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 那就写下来。你现在越来越擅长这个了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Maybe, but...
lines.zh: : 也许吧，可是……

lines.en: : I think that some thoughts are just better left as daydreams.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有些想法，还是只留在白日梦里比较好。

lines.en: scene black
Neither one of us speaks another word for the next ten minutes, but there is a silent understanding that we’re both here because we want to be.
lines.zh: 接下来的十分钟里，我们谁都没有再说话，但我们之间有一份无声的默契——我们待在这儿，都是因为自己想待在这儿。

lines.en: And that we’re both much uglier than we want to be as well.
lines.zh: 也有一份默契是，我们两个都比自己希望的还要丑陋得多。

lines.en: Somewhere around the eleventh minute, our arms stop touching.
lines.zh: 大约在第十一分钟，我们的手臂不再相触。

lines.en: Somewhere around the twelfth, Futaba heads back inside.
